entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, toasted wood, coffee, cashew, caramel, black tea and orange peel give the Hemingway Classic a smooth, aromatic Cameroon profile with nutty sweetness and gentle spice. The smoke should stay woody and creamy through the middle, with caramel and citrus lifting the cedar before a clean coffee-and-nut finish.
